title: Ethiopian Mild Yellow Stew
community: All of Ethiopia — the mild stew for those who prefer no heat
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Alicha Wat — the mild, yellow-golden beef stew made without berbere, seasoned instead with turmeric, ginger, garlic, and onion. The gentler counterpart to Key Wat — served on the same mesob platter as the red wats, providing balance and offering a milder option.
longDesc: Alicha Wat is the other half of Ethiopian cooking — while Key Wat dominates with heat and red colour, Alicha Wat provides the yellow-golden, mild, aromatic counterpoint. Made without berbere and without significant chilli, it is the stew that children and those who cannot handle heat eat, the balance on the mesob platter.
steps: Dry caramelise onions — 20 minutes, no oil.
Add turmeric and ground ginger. Stir 1 minute — do not add berbere.
Add garlic, fresh ginger, coriander, and pepper.
The sauce should be golden-yellow and thick. Season.
chefTips: Alicha Wat should be distinctly yellow — turmeric is generous here.
No berbere at all — the mild flavour is the point.
The dry-caramelised onion base is the same as Key Wat — the technique does not change.
commonMistakes: Adding berbere — this destroys the 'alicha' (mild) character.
cookingScience: Turmeric's curcumin dissolves into the kibbeh fat — distributing the yellow colour and anti-inflammatory compounds uniformly through the stew. Without the competing red carotenoids of berbere, the turmeric produces the characteristic golden-yellow colour.
sustainabilityTips: The mild and spicy wats together form a complete meal — the balance is intentional.
servedWith: Alongside Key Wat on the same platter
healthBenefits: Suitable for those who cannot eat chilli.
culturalNote: Alicha Wat demonstrates the completeness of Ethiopian culinary thinking — every great Ethiopian meal has both a red (spicy) and a yellow (mild) option, providing balance and inclusivity. The mesob platter with both red and yellow wats is the expression of Ethiopian hospitality at its most thoughtful.
